task: fixed frozen-encoder toxicity classification feasibility screen; auxiliary high-vs-low reported HC50, not wet mechanism proof
data: feasibility fold_manifests.json,1428 source candidates,498 after protected-component exclusion; eachfold459-481 after citation-link purge
evidence: published HemoPI2 labels; threshold<=100uM high, >100uM low; assay-specific form/conditions incomplete; no gold or paper-independent claim
encoder: frozen original ProtT5 mean1024, no LoRA/Mamba/3D retraining
heads: two Linear64to1 present in all arms
loss: BCEWithLogits positive weighting from corresponding training labels only
training: same initialization, main minibatches, aux sampling, parameter counts and optimizer steps all arms; shuffled labels fixed per fold seed, preserve class count; baseline also computes aux forward with0loss
scaler: StandardScaler on main training only, same for all arms
evaluation: all6387 training OOF once per arm seed; primary mean of two seed probabilities; fixed threshold0.5; no tuning or early stopping
continue_gate: ensemble DeltaMCC>=0.005 vsbaseline, joint-component bootstrap95% lower>0, eachseed MCC>=baseline, AUPRC drop<=0.002, real auxiliary ensemble MCC>permuted control; no promotion without independent replication
data_quality_sensitivity: not an assay-gold experiment; no model trained on protected auxiliary independent/ToxiPep/ToxMamba/test sequences or their auxiliary components
